topic: The audience that rioted inside cinemas on opening night — and exactly why
hook: The audience rioted inside the cinema on opening night.
script: The audience rioted inside the cinema on opening night. When The Birth of a Nation premiered in 1915, Black Americans and civil rights activists protested and rioted outside theatres across the United States. The film glorified the Ku Klux Klan. President Woodrow Wilson screened it privately and called it history written in lightning. The riots were the first major protest movement against a piece of cinema in American history. Follow for film moments that became political turning points.
